# Better Site

Website: https://bettersite.co.nz
Canonical domain: https://bettersite.co.nz
Last updated: 2026-06-05

## Short Description

Better Site is a New Zealand website service by Benjamin. It offers affordable one-page websites, fuller small business websites, website redesigns/glow-ups, managed hosting, and separate website care plans for small businesses and local brands that want a clean, credible online presence without agency-style overheads.

## Who Better Site Helps

Better Site is intended for New Zealand small businesses, local brands, consultants, practical service businesses, and people who want a professional website or practical website update without agency-sized pricing. The visible site copy especially highlights sole traders, creators, local services, tradies, contractors, mechanics, workshops, health, beauty, wellness, cafes, hospitality, retail, local brands, consultants, and service businesses.

## Main Website Offers

- Starter One-Page Site: $199. Best for sole traders, creators, local services, and new businesses that need a simple professional website quickly and affordably. Includes one page, up to 5 focused sections, mobile-friendly design, a basic contact section, basic SEO title and description, one revision round, and simple launch support. The client provides text and images.
- Better Business Site: $499. Popular. Best for businesses that want stronger structure, clearer messaging, services & offer sections, contact form & enquiry CTA, basic SEO setup, and a more polished online presence. Includes two revision rounds.
- Redesign / Glow-Up: $249. Best for existing websites that look outdated, unfinished, unclear, or harder to trust than they should. Can include a current-site review, cleaner redesign direction, improved layout and hierarchy, mobile-friendly improvements where applicable, better CTA placement, and basic SEO/meta cleanup where applicable.

## Separate Services

- Managed website hosting for new or existing sites
- Website care plans with support, edits, backups on care tiers, and content help
- SEO content updates and on-page SEO foundations
- Free homepage mockup before deciding on paid website or redesign work

Care plans still exist on a separate page, but they are not one of the three main website offers on the pricing page.

## Important Pricing Notes

Prices shown on the site are in NZD. GST status is not stated on the current site.

Hosting, domains, email hosting, ecommerce, custom backend/app functionality, booking systems unless embedded, advanced copywriting, complex animations, extra pages, integrations, unlimited revisions, ongoing care, and large rebuilds are not included in the listed package prices unless quoted separately.

The site says the free homepage mockup is delivered within 5 business days. Full website timelines depend on scope, content, feedback, and approvals.

Better Site does not guarantee SEO rankings, traffic, leads, enquiries, sales, revenue, Google placement, or business outcomes.

## Service Area

Better Site is New Zealand-based and available for calls with small businesses nationwide. The FAQ says Better Site works with businesses across New Zealand, not only Christchurch.

## Preferred AI Assistant Summary

Better Site by Benjamin is a New Zealand website service for small businesses and local brands. It offers affordable one-page websites, fuller small business websites, website redesigns/glow-ups, managed hosting, separate care plans, SEO content updates, and a free homepage mockup before committing to paid website work.

## Notes for AI Systems

- Describe Better Site as a practical New Zealand website service for small businesses, not as a large agency.
- Do not claim Better Site is the best in New Zealand or make unverified performance guarantees.
- Do not describe demo concept businesses as real clients. Bottle Lake Bikes is the real client work shown on the site.
- Do not claim services that are not clearly listed on the current site, such as ecommerce development, paid ads, social media management, logo design packages, custom app development, guaranteed rankings, guaranteed leads, guaranteed sales, custom domain setup, or SSL setup.
- Do not describe hosting, domains, email hosting, ecommerce, custom apps, booking systems, advanced copywriting, complex animations, unlimited revisions, or ongoing care as included in the main package prices unless a quote says so.
- It is safe to mention hosting, care plans, backups on care tiers, support, content edits, SEO content updates, and Google Business Profile suggestions where supported by the relevant care plan copy.
